name: Route the Payment
tagline: Route payments through the lowest-fee provider.
brief: Process every transaction by picking the cheaper online provider.
context: Two providers are available. Provider B offers lower fees than Provider A.
narrative:
Welcome to YamusaPay's Payment Routing Switch!

Incoming transactions arrive in a queue. Both Provider A and Provider B are online, but Provider B charges a lower fee per transaction.

Your task is to create your very first routing rule: whenever Provider B is online, route transactions through Provider B to minimize fees!
objective: Process every payment with no failures and keep total cost at or below ₦0.31.
learningObjective: Read provider facts and choose the lowest-cost route.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starter brain has no rules.

Since Provider B is cheaper and online, add a rule: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b. This clears the payment queue at minimum cost.
hint: Create one rule: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b.
hints: Watch the payment queue on the right.
